page0.text:
The day ends.
I still feel uneasy with Saber sleeping so close by, so I escape to the shed.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page0:1

page1.text:
"..."
I stop and look up at the winter sky.
...Not because the night sky is particularly beautiful.
I'm just feeling the winter chill in a daze, doing nothing, because it calms me.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page1:1

page2.text:
I don't know how much time passed.
I think I hear footsteps in the darkness.
"...Who's there?"
There's no answer.
Footsteps approach, and I feel a piercing presence.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page2:1

page3.text:
...
I crouch, ready to jump back at any time.
"Hey. I asked who's there."
There's no answer.
The footsteps never stop, and the person finally appears before me.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page3:1

page4.text:
...
"You're..."
It's the Servant who fought Lancer at school the other night.
The red-armored knight Saber beat when she leaped over the wall...
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page4:1

page5.text:
"Are you Tohsaka's Servant...Archer?"
The man's lips curve upward.
He smiled...can I take that as confirmation?
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page5:1

page6.text:
...
Something about him annoys me.
For no reason I can really understand, I find myself irritated. I can't make myself like this guy.
I've never talked to him before, and he's never attacked me before.
But I realize something the instant I see his face.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page6:1

page7.text:
...I can't respect this man.
There's no reason for it that I can think of, but he and I aren't going to get along.
I'm probably not the only one who feels like this. Archer probably feels he same way.
There must be a total of three people in the world with whom I'm just completely incompatible.
That's how bad it is. I wouldn't be surprised if he was irritable around me too.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page7:1

page8.text:
"What do you want? I thought you were going to stay on guard until your wounds healed up."
"That is my intention. The moment my wounds heal, I'm putting an end to this ridiculous alliance you two formed. So, I've remained a spectator all this time since I believed there was nothing for me to say to you."
"Don't let me stop you from spectating, then. There's nothing I want to talk to you about, either."
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page8:1

page9.text:
"As much as I would like to do that, there's just one thing I cannot overlook.
I hear you don't intend to let Saber fight."
"What's wrong with that?"
My reply is impulsive.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page9:1

page10.text:
...
He glares.
With a fair amount of hostility, Archer makes it clear he sees right through me.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page10:1

page11.text:
"I knew it. Only a brat would do something like that.
You won't accept help from anyone. You'll just do everything yourself.
On top of it all, you don't want any casualties. That mentality disgusts me."
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page11:1

page12.text:
"What!? You have no right to tell me that!
I'm only doing what I think is right! You have no reason to complain!"
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page12:1

page13.text: "I do, actually. As a fellow Servant, I understand Saber's hardship. Saber has a heavy weight to carry with a Master like you."
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page13:1

page14.text:
"Gh—!?"
He's not lying.
But what really ticks me off is that I didn't want to hear this from him of all people.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page14:1

page15.text: "Screw you! I'm not a burden to Saber! I'm going to fight in her place, so  there shouldn't be a problem!"
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page15:1

page16.text:
"Hmph. Are you saying she won't get hurt as long as she doesn't fight? Servants only exist to fight. Forbidding her to fight is blasphemous...though I doubt there's any point telling you that."
Having said what was on his mind, Archer falls silent.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page16:1

page17.text:
A few minutes pass.
The two of us just stare at each other.
...
I gulp.
His cold stare seems to be trying to probe my insides.
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page17:1

page18.text:
And then suddenly...
"So, what's your plan, Master of Saber?"
The red knight seems calm as he asks his question.
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page18:1

page19.text:
"What do you mean?"
"Do you really expect to end this war without fighting? Do you really think you'll never fight or kill anyone?"
"I never said I won't fight. I'll fight if I need to fight."
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page19:1

page20.text:
"I see. But you won't kill anyone when you fight?"
"Yeah. Got a problem with that?"
"I have no intention of butting into your moronic reasons for doing what you do. I don't have the time, and I'm just not crazy enough to try."
Archer turns his back to me.
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page20:1

page21.text:
"Don't get things confused, though. This champion of justice you're pretending to be? Nothing more than a cleaner. You should know that only the survivor is going to have a chance to save anyone that way."
...
I don't know why.
But it felt like Archer was just beating up on me for no reason.
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page21:1

page22.text: "Wait. What do you mean a champion of justice is just a cleaner?"
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page22:1

page23.text:
"You should have figured it out by now.
Listen. Your approach won't undo a tragic death.
That's the limitation you're working within.
A champion of justice is someone who can only clean up a mess that's already been made. You'll never be able to save the very people you're hoping to save."
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page23:1

page24.text:
"..."
That's...not true.
The idea that you can't save the person you're reaching out to save is...wrong.
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page24:1

page25.text:
"An ideal is just that: an ideal. As long as you hold to that ideal, the friction between it and reality will only get more intense. That's the path you're on right now.
Someday you're going to face reality, and you'll have to pay the price. The choices you've made will cost many, many lives."
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page25:1

page26.text:
"Wha...!"
"You should at least be prepared. By the time you realize how narrow-minded you've been, you'll have to figure out how to fix it, and who to punish for it.
If you can't do that, then I suggest you abandon both your dream and your magecraft right now."
Archer disappears into the darkness.
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page26:1

page27.text:
"Listen. No matter what anyone does, there will always be those who can't be saved. All your ideal will let you save is the ideal itself. There is so little a human can do.
But even so..."
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page27:1

page28.text:
"Hey wait! What the hell are you trying to say!?"
My question is swallowed up in the darkness.
Archer is already gone, and I'm just talking to empty air.
page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page28:1

page29.text:
"What the hell's with him? He just showed up, unloaded a bunch of crap on me, and disappeared!"
He was telling me that my thinking is too idealistic, and I'm going to suffer for it soon.
But how can I decide something is wrong before I've even tried it?
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page29:1

page30.text:
"I'm ready. If I'm wrong, I'll just have to pay for that mistake with my life."
That's my resolve as a mage.
Archer doesn't have to remind me that.
page30.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page30:1

page31.text:
"Hmph. I really can't stand that guy."
But...
Something he said bothers me.
page31.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page31:1

page32.text:
No matter what anyone does, there will always be those who can't be saved.
There is so little a human can do.
But even so...
page32.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page32:1

page33.text:
"Even so...can I keep pursuing my ideal without ever looking back?"
I mutter to myself.
It felt like that's what Archer wanted to say.
page33.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-03:page33:1
